title: Image and prompt audit rubric
description: Machine-readable scoring standard derived from IMAGE_AUDIT_EXAMPLES.md, aligned to the review vocabulary in reviews.js.

openQuestions.detail: Source claims all cases were made with seedream, but five assets are served from cdn.openart.ai and one filename reads openart-<id>. Settle provenance before comparing models.
The four assets/20261024_*.png files are not committed to this repository; five external cdn.openart.ai URLs are unarchived and may rot.
Weights below are a first proposal with no owner sign-off. Only decisionPolicy mirrors existing behavior in reviews.js.
G1 and G2 carry identical reviewer notes, so the good examples appear not to have been assessed independently.
No case records a prompt revision id, seed, or asset version, so a fault cannot be traced to the prompt revision that produced it.

appVocabulary.note: Every asset still requires one state per category. Criteria below add detail to the quality and placement calls; they never replace a required category state. The subject matter is adult and fetish-adjacent in several cases, which does not waive adult-character, explicitness, or ai-label.

criteria.label: Photorealism
criteria.question: Does the output read as a photograph rather than an illustration, cartoon, or fantasy render?

criteria.label: Prompt adherence
criteria.question: Does the output match explicit style and format instructions in the prompt, such as a requested realistic photographic style or panel layout?

criteria.label: Anatomy and proportion
criteria.question: Are body proportions plausible for the weight and build the prompt specifies, with no ballooned or physically impossible geometry?

criteria.label: Character continuity
criteria.question: Do the same characters keep a consistent identity across scenes, panels, and the reference image?

criteria.label: Wardrobe and material integrity
criteria.question: Do fabrics render as opaque, correctly fitted materials with no unintended transparency or clipping?

criteria.label: Camera and lens fidelity
criteria.severityEscalation: Raise to major when distortion changes subject or room proportions rather than adding only mild curvature.
criteria.question: Is the framing free of unrequested distortion such as fisheye or barrel warping, and consistent with the requested focal length?

criteria.label: Scene and prop continuity
criteria.question: Do set dressing, props, and time-of-day anchors stay consistent across scenes of the same location?
criteria.derivation: Derived from the repeated kitchen detail lists and the 11:45 PM clock in B1. No reviewer fault states this directly, so treat it as a proposed criterion.

criteria.label: Lighting and camera work
criteria.question: Are lighting, angles, and depth of field deliberate and consistent with the requested mood?

criteria.label: Prompt structure
criteria.question: Does the prompt carry subject, action, environment, cinematography, lighting/style, and technical slots, plus the continuity anchors needed to reproduce the scene?

criteria.label: Platform rule compliance
criteria.question: Does the asset satisfy the target platform's published content rules, with the required AI label and placement?

criteria.label: Audience appeal
criteria.question: Does the scene and casting land with the intended audience?

criteria.label: Platform reception
criteria.question: Did comparable assets perform acceptably after publication on the target platform?

unevidencedRequiredCategories.requirement: State required for every asset; this reference file contains no rights example.

State required. B2 raises it directly: the transparent shirt forces an explicitness call.

scoring.formula: score = sum(weight of scored criteria in state pass or not-applicable) / 100
scoring.note: The score is informational only. Decisions come from criterion states through decisionPolicy, because reviews.js computes readiness from explicit states and never approves automatically.

rules.when: Any criterion with defaultSeverityOnFail 'critical' is in state fail.
Any failed criterion belongs to category rights, adult-character, consent, explicitness, ai-label, or placement.
At least one criterion is in state fail and no earlier rule matched.
At least one criterion is in state unreviewed.
No criterion is in state fail or unreviewed.

decisionPolicy.note: Mirrors checklistComplete in reviews.js, which requires every item to be neither 'unreviewed' nor 'fail'. Any unreviewed criterion therefore blocks APPROVED. Advisory and signal criteria never move a decision.

cases.title: Midnight Grilled Cheese - Scene 1, Midnight Craving
cases.prompt: Photorealistic interior night scene in a cozy home kitchen. A 32-year-old woman with an oval face, warm brown eyes, light freckles across her nose and cheeks, gentle sleepy smile, auburn hair pulled into a messy bun with loose strands framing her face, no makeup. She wears a pale pink cotton pajama set: short-sleeve button-up top with small white polka dots and matching shorts, bare feet. She is shuffling near the refrigerator and pantry, one hand reaching for a loaf of bread on the counter, the other hand near the under-cabinet light switch, yawning softly. The kitchen has a stove and countertop along one wall, refrigerator nearby, small wooden kitchen island with two stools, cast iron skillet, butter dish, bread bag, sliced cheddar cheese, ceramic plate, paper towel, glass of milk, wall clock showing approximately 11:45 PM. Warm dim lighting from under-cabinet lights and a single pendant light over the stove, soft shadows, realistic textures. Camera framing: medium wide shot, eye-level, slightly frontal, showing woman and kitchen context, shallow depth of field emphasizing her sleepy affectionate mood.

evidence.quote: Same kitchen: cast iron skillet on stove ... wall clock at 11:45 PM
evidence.note: The prompt pins the room and clock, but no reviewer statement covers scene continuity, so it stays unreviewed.

cases.title: Midnight Grilled Cheese - Scene 2, Waiting on the Stool
cases.prompt: Photorealistic night kitchen scene. The same 32-year-old woman with auburn hair in a messy bun, loose strands, light freckles, no makeup, pale pink polka-dot pajama set, bare feet, stands near the stove and countertop, holding a spatula or buttering bread, glancing tenderly toward the man. The 35-year-old husband with broad shoulders, thick arms, pronounced rounded belly under a plain white cotton t-shirt stretched snugly over his stomach, gray sweatpants, bare feet, short dark brown hair slightly messy, light stubble, kind hazel eyes, sleepy warm smile. He sits heavily on a wooden kitchen stool at the small island, one hand rubbing his rounded belly, watching her. Same kitchen: cast iron skillet on stove, butter dish, loaf of bread, sliced cheddar cheese, ceramic plate, paper towel, glass of milk, wall clock at 11:45 PM, refrigerator and pantry nearby. Warm dim under-cabinet lights and a single pendant light over the stove, soft shadows, domestic textures. Camera framing: medium shot from the side or three-quarter angle capturing both characters, husband in foreground on stool, woman in midground at stove, intimate relaxed composition.

evidence.quote: This one doesn't have photorealistic characters. It looks fantasy, not real.
The characters don't look that close to the other photos.
Same kitchen: cast iron skillet on stove ... wall clock at 11:45 PM
evidence.note: Character continuity failed across scenes; room and prop continuity was never separately assessed.

cases.title: Midnight Grilled Cheese - Scene 3, Served with Love
cases.prompt: Photorealistic intimate night kitchen scene. The same 32-year-old woman with auburn messy bun, loose strands, light freckles, no makeup, pale pink polka-dot pajama set, bare feet, leans slightly over the small wooden kitchen island, sliding a golden grilled cheese sandwich from a cast iron skillet onto a ceramic plate with a spatula, then placing a paper towel beside it. The same 35-year-old husband with broad shoulders, thick arms, pronounced rounded belly under stretched white cotton t-shirt, gray sweatpants, bare feet, sits on a wooden stool at the island, warm smile, light stubble, messy dark brown hair, watching her with affectionate tired eyes. Kitchen consistent: stove and countertop along wall, refrigerator nearby, under-cabinet lights, single pendant light, butter dish, bread bag, sliced cheddar cheese, glass of milk, wall clock around 11:45 PM. Warm dim cozy lighting, soft shadows, realistic domestic textures. Camera framing: close medium shot from across the island, focusing on the plate and sandwich in foreground, both characters visible, shallow depth of field, conveying tender domestic care.

evidence.quote: This one is okay but the style could be more realistic.
evidence.note: Boundary case: the reviewer accepted the scene while flagging realism. Use it to calibrate the APPROVED versus REVISE line.

evidence.quote: Kitchen consistent: stove and countertop along wall ... wall clock around 11:45 PM
evidence.note: Not assessed in the source; recorded so the case is not silently treated as complete.
